answer: In an agent economy a concrete Sybil defense requires each identity to post collateral on a glacier of locked tokens sitting on a verified ledge of past activity. A public beacon of honest attestations multiplies the effective weight of that stake. An attacker who spins up many fake agents must duplicate the entire glacier deposit for every new identity because the ledge history cannot be shared or forged cheaply; the cost therefore scales linearly with the number of Sybils while honest agents keep a single pool.
